title: static-s3-operator Helm values
description: Values for the static-s3-operator chart. The `operator` block is validated strictly, so a mistyped setting is reported by `helm install` rather than silently ignored.

nameOverride.description: Partially override the generated resource names, keeping the release name.

fullnameOverride.description: Fully override the generated resource names.

operator.description: Operator behaviour. Every setting here becomes a command line flag on the manager.

defaults.description: Defaults applied to StaticSite fields that are left unset, so a site only spells out what makes it different.

sourcePath.description: Directory inside the site image whose contents become the site root, used when a StaticSite omits spec.source.path.

pullInterval.description: How often a mutable image tag is re-resolved, used when a StaticSite omits spec.source.pullInterval. "0" disables polling.

bucketNameTemplate.description: Go template generating a bucket name for a StaticSite that omits spec.bucket.name, rendered with {{ .OpaqueID }}, {{ .ShortID }}, {{ .Namespace }}, {{ .Name }} and {{ .UID }}. A bucket name reaches public DNS, so prefer the opaque identifier over the namespace and name.

bucketNameUUIDNamespace.description: UUID namespace that {{ .OpaqueID }} is derived under, which is what makes a generated bucket name unguessable. Empty reads the kube-system namespace UID, which is stable per cluster; set it explicitly to keep names stable across clusters, or when rbac.namespaced is true.

region.description: S3 region, used when a StaticSite omits spec.bucket.region.

endpoint.description: S3 API endpoint for an S3-compatible provider, used when a StaticSite omits spec.bucket.endpoint. Empty means AWS S3.

forcePathStyle.description: Address buckets as endpoint/bucket instead of bucket.endpoint. Most S3-compatible providers need this.

websiteEndpointTemplate.description: Go template for a site's public URL, evaluated with {{ .Bucket }}, {{ .Region }}, {{ .Endpoint }} (the endpoint's host, port included and scheme excluded), {{ .EndpointURL }} (the whole endpoint, scheme included) and {{ .Scheme }}. The ExternalName Service aliases the hostname of whatever this renders, so a template that does not produce a URL yields a broken CNAME rather than an error.

indexDocument.description: Object served for directory requests, used when a StaticSite omits spec.bucket.website.indexDocument.

errorDocument.description: Object served for 4xx responses. Empty configures no error document; set it to the index document for a client-routed single page application.

cacheControl.description: Cache-Control header for objects matched by no spec.sync.cacheControl rule. Empty sends no header.

externalDNS.description: The ExternalName Service the operator maintains for each site.

hostnameAnnotation.description: Annotation key that spec.service.hostnames are rendered into. Empty renders no hostname annotation.

image.description: Image for sync Jobs. Leave empty so the operator reuses its own image, which keeps the manager and syncer in lockstep across an upgrade.

imagePullPolicy.description: Pull policy for the syncer image.

maxExtractBytes.description: Largest total size a sync Job will unpack from an image.

maxExtractFiles.description: Largest number of files a sync Job will unpack from an image.

syncRetryBaseDelay.description: First retry delay after a failed sync.

syncRetryMaxDelay.description: Upper bound on the retry delay, and the deadline after which a failing teardown gives the bucket up rather than wedging the finalizer.

ownershipRecheckInterval.description: How often an idle, healthy site re-verifies its bucket configuration and ownership record.

s3.description: S3 client behaviour for non-AWS providers.

requestChecksumWhenSupported.description: Send trailing CRC32 checksums on every upload. Off by default because several S3-compatible providers reject those requests.

skipTLSVerify.description: Do not verify S3 endpoint certificates. Development only.

credentials.description: S3 credentials for sites that name none of their own. Prefer existingSecret so the access key never lands in a values file or a Helm release.

create.description: Render a Secret from accessKeyID and secretAccessKey below.

accessKeyID.description: Access key ID, used only when create is true.

secretAccessKey.description: Secret access key, used only when create is true.

sessionToken.description: Session token for temporary credentials, used only when create is true.

existingSecret.description: Name of a Secret that already exists in the release namespace. Mutually exclusive with create.

accessKeyIDKey.description: Key within the Secret holding the access key ID.

secretAccessKeyKey.description: Key within the Secret holding the secret access key.

sessionTokenKey.description: Key within the Secret holding an optional session token.

mirrorToSiteNamespaces.description: Copy the credentials into a site's namespace so its sync Job can read them. With this off, every StaticSite outside the release namespace must set spec.bucket.credentials.

allOf.description: create and existingSecret are two ways of naming the same Secret, so only one may be used.
Rendering a Secret needs both halves of the access key.

namespaced.description: Install a Role and RoleBinding scoped to the release namespace instead of cluster-wide RBAC.

enabled.description: Install convenience admin, editor and viewer roles for StaticSite.
Install the StaticSite CRD with the chart.

keep.description: Keep the CRD when the release is uninstalled. Removing it deletes every StaticSite, and with them their buckets.

port.description: Port the metrics endpoint binds to.

secure.description: Serve metrics over HTTPS with authn/authz (true) or plain HTTP (false).

readers.description: Service accounts bound to the metrics-reader ClusterRole, permitting them to scrape /metrics. Required when secure is set, since the endpoint authorizes scrapers through a SubjectAccessReview and refuses unbound ones with 403.

enabled.description: Issue a self-signed certificate for the metrics endpoint through cert-manager, have the manager serve it, and have the ServiceMonitor verify against it rather than skipping verification. Requires cert-manager in the cluster.
